messages:
Arjun: Heads-up: saw a small spike in embed request latencies during the EU canary. looks correlated with mixed-dim batches (512+1536).
Deepa: can you paste a sample ingress log line?
Arjun: snippet: `WARN ingress shard=eu-1 tenant=x-99 route=embeds size=2.1MB dims=[512,1536] action=split-frag created_jobs=18 delay_ms=420`
Sasha: ugly. fragmentation multiplies overhead. we should have a console metric for "fragmentation-rate" (percent of requests that create >1 job).
Mike: +1. Suggest we bucket fragmentation by created_jobs: 2,3-5,6+. lower cardinality and easier alerts.
Deepa: For telemetry tag names, keep it short: `frag_bucket=2|3-5|6+` and `shape_class=mixed|uniform` also `router.decision=hinted|preflight|override`.
Arjun: Do we already compute estimated token-equivalent units? Ops asked for cost impact per spike.
Mike: runtime emits `est_units` per request. we can sum that and compare to a hypothetical preflight-honored baseline to show "wasted units". but the baseline needs the X-Embed-Shape hint from clients.
Sasha: UX idea: route detail page shows a time-series: frag_rate, avg_created_jobs, and an overlay of "estimated wasted units" with a toggle to view absolute vs % of throughput.
Deepa: We must be careful with tenant privacy. console should only show anonymized top samples (hash prefix + count).
Arjun: alert proposal: fire when 1-minute frag_rate > 1% AND avg_created_jobs >=3. Early warning for perf regressions.
Mike: can we make the alert window asymmetric for canary? e.g., 1-min for canary, 5-min for prod. configurable via feature-flag.
Sasha: yes. Also add a safe-mode: if frag_rate triggers and preflight-accepted < 20%, route to small-model fastpath fallback for affected tenants. but need SRE signoff.
metrics-bot: metric created: `ingress.frag_rate` tagged by `frag_bucket,shape_class,router.decision` (backfilled 2h)
Deepa: I'll mock the dashboard widget and post screenshots. will also add a backfill job to compute baseline wasted units for the last 24h.
Arjun: action items: Deepa -> dashboard mock + backfill job; Mike -> emit frag_bucket tag and ensure est_units present; Sasha -> write alert runbook and coordinate SRE fallback approval.
Mike: small API note: please standardize the header we expect: `X-Embed-Shape: dims=512,1536;count=2` (semicolon separator). we'll add parsing in ingress.
Sasha: leave a note for SDK teams to optionally set shape hints; makes a big difference.
Arjun: thanks all. will monitor the canary for the next 3 hours and report if frag_rate stays elevated.
